children: Doosan Robotics and peaq partner to enable financeable robots that can monetize spare capacity. The first Doosan A-Series robot is already running the full peaqOS Pro stack, and the companies plan additional robot integrations and machine-financing pilots. Doosan Robotics ranks among the top five collaborative robot makers.

The integration gives peaq an enterprise reference in Physical AI, since a top-five cobot manufacturer now ships a robot on its operating system. Machine-financing pilots point toward a model where robots are funded against the income they generate on-chain, which would extend peaq's machine-economy narrative beyond individual device onboarding. Adoption is early, with one live robot currently running the stack, so the partnership's weight depends on how many units and financing programs follow.
BREAKING: peaq and Doosan Robotics, one of the world’s top 5 collaborative robot makers, enter Physical AI partnership
Doosan and peaq are working to enable easily financeable robots that monetize their spare capacity
The first Doosan robot is already running peaqOS 🔥
